units.source_text: 这个少女的生平，所知道的就这些了，其他的事情还未听说，然而这件事已经很震撼了。

en.t: This is all that is known about the life of this young woman; nothing else has been heard, yet this matter alone is already deeply astonishing.

units.source_text: 她活着的时候无上尊严，没有谁可以和她匹敌。

en.t: While she was alive, she possessed supreme dignity, and no one could rival her.

units.source_text: 世间旅途入茫茫夜海，一波崛起，可以和新月的明光接触，苟然之人，没有机会感受到生命真正的意义。

en.t: The journey through this world enters a vast night sea; when a single wave rises, it may touch the bright light of the new moon, but those who live carelessly have no chance to feel the true meaning of life.

units.source_text: 因此，了解罗连生命最后发生的事，也足以了解罗连的一生了！

en.t: Therefore, to know what happened at the end of Loren's life is enough to understand Loren's whole life.
